content: VERIFIED via crates.io API: pyo3 latest stable is 0.29.0 (released 2026-06-11), preceded by 0.28.3 (2026-04-02); 0.28.0/0.28.1 were yanked for a subclassing soundness bug. abi3/abi3t features remain the mechanism for version-independent wheels; abi3t (paired with PEP 803) adds free-threaded compatibility.
